title: Privacy policy
intro: This notice explains what personal data MECHWARE handles and why. It is written to follow the Personal Data Protection Ordinance 2025 and will be available in Bangla and English.

p: When you create an account, place an order or ask for a quote we handle the data needed for that: your name and contact details, your delivery details and your order history.
For company accounts we also handle the company profile: trade licence, BIN and TIN.
Full list of data categories: [to be confirmed].
We ask for explicit consent for each purpose. Consent is specific to that purpose, can be withdrawn at any time, and a record of it is kept.
In your account you will be able to ask for an export of your data, a correction, or deletion or anonymisation of your data.
When these requests become available: [to be confirmed].
Tax records are kept for as long as the law requires. Other retention periods: [to be confirmed].
Card details are entered on the payment provider's hosted page and never reach our servers.
List of processors and any transfer of data outside Bangladesh: [to be confirmed].
